feeds.title: PRIDE
feeds.description: The LGBTQ experience is more than just a rainbow flag, it's a movement. The PRIDE podcast hosted by Levi Chambers celebrates every person under the queer umbrella with skillful journalism and engaging interviews. Ever wondered about the queer pirates of the Caribbean? How about the origins of the expression 'coming out' or the queer history of the United States? Join us as we provide a platform to LGBTQ+ people with stories to tell — stories about sexuality, gender, love, laughter or anything that unleashes your curiosity...

feeds.title: Sydney Gay Counselling Blog
feeds.description: Sydney Gay Counselling provides individual and couple counselling and therapy services to the Sydney LGBTI community. Gay Blog of articles, research and tips on how to live a great gay life, produced by Sydney Gay Counselling.

feeds.title: Star Observer
feeds.description: Australia's leading gay and lesbian news source. Delivering the very best news, features, human stories, views and general information about and to Australia's gay, lesbian, bisexual, trans and intersex community.

feeds.title: DNA Magazine
feeds.description: DNA is Australia's best-selling magazine for gay men. Every month, you'll find great feature stories, celebrity profiles, pop culture reviews and sensational photography of some of the world's sexiest male models in our fashion stories. DNA was launched in Australia in 2000.

feeds.title: Gay Nation
feeds.description: Gay Nation is the online magazine of the Gay Community. Covering local and international News. Gay Nation is the home of your community. The all-new, fresh, innovative gay community website was established in February 2015 to fill a void in the New Zealand gay media. Today Gay Nation has not only etched a place in the NZ media landscape but is now becoming the online publication of choice for gay men in Australia and across many countries in Asia, Europe and the United States of America.

feeds.title: Gay Celebrant Melbourne Blog
feeds.description: Hi - my name's Bronte Price and I'm a civil marriage celebrant. I'm also gay and a long-term active advocate for marriage equality. At Gay Celebrant Melbourne, we work together to create a ceremony that's authentic, personal & unique. The blog features some of the weddings I have officiated, tips for your choice of wedding including small ceremony, elopement, lavish luxury weddings and more!

feeds.title: Lifesavers with Pride Blog
feeds.description: The national group of gay and lesbian Australian surf lifesavers and their friends.

feeds.title: Husbands that Travel Blog
feeds.description: Hi! We're Charlie and Michael, two husbands traveling to Australia by van! Almost every week, we post a new Australia travel blog for tips on traveling to Australia as a gay / LGBT person to inspire you for your future adventures in Australia!

feeds.title: Acceptance Sydney
feeds.description: Acceptance is a faith community existing for almost four decades, supporting gay, lesbian, bisexual, and transgender (GLBT) Catholics, their family, and friends. By providing a safe, spiritual, and social environment, through Acceptance, many GLBT Catholics have found reconciliation with their faith and sexuality. Discover the latest news from the ministry, our beloved popes and bishops, catholic news and more in the blog.

feeds.title: Gay Stay Australia Blog
feeds.description: LGBT Travel Australia. The Pink Pages - LGBT directory including accommodation, tours, businesses, community groups and events.
